findings.one_line: The asserted strict positivity of u_d and c_{d,k} uses substantive-table and hazard positivity, but neither ass:substantive-positivity nor ass:hazard-positivity is declared in depends_on; add both dependencies (or weaken the lemma).

cited_checks.note: The attested Proposition 2.27 applies to centered categorical indicator vectors scaled by n^{-1/2}: boundedness gives Lindeberg and the covariance sum is diag(o)-oo^T. The source labels it Proposition 2.27 although the locator says Theorem 2.27.
The attested Theorem 3.1 applies with r_n=sqrt(n), theta=o, and phi=F; the linear image of the stated Gaussian has covariance DF(o)[diag(o)-oo^T]DF(o)^T.
